title: Normalized section algebras descend over affine base opens
statement: Let $h:Z\to S$ be a quasi-compact separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $N$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Z$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Let $I$ be any index type and let $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ be an affine open cover of $S$. Write $j_i:Z_i=h^{-1}(U_i)\hookrightarrow Z$, $h_i:Z_i\to U_i$, and $N_i=j_i^*N$, with the actual tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Suppose for every $i$ a relative section algebra $A_i$ for $(h_i,N_i)$ is given [def-sfb-relative-section-algebra-canonical-map]. Then there exists a relative section algebra $A$ for $(h,N)$ and, for every $i$, a coefficientwise pullback datum $D_i$ from $A.data$ to $A_i.data$ along $U_i\hookrightarrow S$ [def-nagata-graded-algebra-pullback-data, def-nagata-relative-proj]. For every affine open $V\subset S$, affine open $W\subset U_i$ with $W\subset (U_i\hookrightarrow S)^{-1}(V)$, every $n\geq0$, and every homogeneous $a\in A(V)_n$, the section associated to $D_i(a)$ in $\Gamma(h_i^{-1}W,N_i^{\otimes n})$ is the restriction of the specified tensor-power comparison applied to $1\otimes\operatorname{sectionEquiv}_{V,n}(a)$. The section $1\otimes s$ means the normalized tensor-pullback section, and the comparison is boundaryPullbackPowIso [def-sc-tensor-pullback-power-comparison], including its degree-zero unit comparison. Tensor powers use [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. There is no generation or canonical-map hypothesis.

proof.text: For each affine V in S take the externally graded ring whose degree n component is Gamma(h inverse V, N tensor n). Multiplication is tensor multiplication of sections, and the unit is the section 1 of the degree-zero structure module. Additivity, the associativity, symmetry and unit identities of tensor powers give the graded ring laws. Restriction of sections gives the ring restriction maps and their identities. Each homogeneous sheaf h_*(N tensor n) restricts on U_i to the corresponding sheaf for the restricted morphism: the normalized pullback unit is 1 tensor s, followed by the tensor-power comparison. This gives the displayed section formula, including n = 0. The given local section identifications identify these sheaves with the local quasi-coherent homogeneous pieces. Quasi-coherence is local on the base, so all global pieces are quasi-coherent. On affine inclusions their restriction maps consequently exhibit scalar extension; thus the externally graded section rings form the existing GradedAlgebraData. The identity maps on homogeneous sections give sectionEquiv and its scalar, unit, multiplication and restriction laws. On an affine W of U_i mapping into V, the same restriction formula defines a graded ring map into A_local i by its inverse section identifications. It respects multiplication and the unit and is coefficientwise base change by quasi-coherence. Restriction on either side commutes with it because all maps are restrictions of the same sections. This is PullbackData with exactly the required normalization. Empty schemes and empty covers cause no exception: all section modules on the empty scheme are zero.

theorem exists_section_algebra_open_cover_descent {Z S : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact h] [IsSeparated h] (N : Z.Modules) [N.IsInvertible]
    {I : Type v} (U : I → S.Opens) (hU : ∀ i : I, IsAffineOpen (U i))
    (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (A_local : ∀ i : I, RelativeSectionAlgebra (h ∣_ U i)
      ((tensorPullback (h ⁻¹ᵁ U i).ι).obj N)) :
    ∃ A : RelativeSectionAlgebra h N, ∀ i : I,
      ∃ D : Scheme.GradedAlgebraData.PullbackData (U i).ι A.data (A_local i).data,
        ∀ (V : S.affineOpens) (W : (U i).toScheme.affineOpens)
          (hle : W.1 ≤ (U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) (n : ℕ) (a : A.data.grading V n),
        (A_local i).sectionEquiv W n
            ⟨D.map hle a, (D.map hle).map_mem a.property⟩ =
          (((tensorPullback (h ⁻¹ᵁ U i).ι).obj N).tensorPow n).val.map
            (homOfLE (by
              intro x hx
              change h ((h ⁻¹ᵁ U i).ι x) ∈ V.1
              rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← morphismRestrict_ι]
              exact hle hx)).op
            ((boundaryPullbackPowIso (h ⁻¹ᵁ U i).ι N n).hom.app _
              (tensorPullbackSection (h ⁻¹ᵁ U i).ι (N.tensorPow n) (h ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
                (A.sectionEquiv V n a)))
